# Chiefly

> Chiefly is a personal chief of staff that lives on your computer. Local by default, cloud only if you opt in. You pay once, and your Chiefly keeps working, even if we don’t.

Jarvis was the codename. Chiefly is the product: a personal chief of staff that lives on your computer.

The waitlist is open. A private alpha runs in October 2026.

## Principles

- You own it. You don’t rent it.
- Local by default. Cloud only if you opt in.
- Your Chiefly keeps working, even if we don’t.
- It works for you, and only you.
- You can delete it anytime.

## Names

- Company: Chiefly
- Product: Chiefly
- Codename: Jarvis
- Site: https://chieflyos.com/
